turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Okay so the animals are all fed and I'm like, totally bored...

turns.speaker: rook
turns.text: Hm. Grab a rag. Scrub these pots.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: On it, I can totally make these pots look like new!

turns.speaker: rook
turns.text: Don't just talk. Get to it.

turns.speaker: moth
turns.text: I think, well, maybe, this tea is exactly what I need right now.

turns.speaker: lux
turns.text: Of course you have forgotten to eat, my dear, though I suppose the pursuit of science is a poor substitute for sustenance.

turns.speaker: moth
turns.text: I think the data is more important than a meal, but I should probably eat soon.

turns.speaker: lux
turns.text: Naturally, the data will remain quite indifferent to your starvation, but the tea is getting cold.

turns.speaker: ash
turns.text: Copy. Keep that meat off the sandbags, Tuk.

turns.speaker: ash
turns.text: Negative. Do not sit there while the sun is down.

turns.speaker: tuk
turns.text: Tuk will sit. This meat is good.

turns.speaker: lux
turns.text: Of course, my dear Nate, the culinary monotony of this settlement is becoming quite a profound hardship.

turns.speaker: rook
turns.text: Hm. It's stew, Lux. Eat it or don't.

turns.speaker: lux
turns.text: One does not eat for sustenance alone, Nate; one eats to avoid the sensation of being perpetually insulted by a spoon.

turns.speaker: rook
turns.text: If you want fancy, go find a silver platter and a chef.

turns.speaker: moth
turns.text: I think, well, maybe it was just the dog, Pip, that startled me.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Okay so he's like totally harmless, he just likes to say hi to people...

turns.speaker: moth
turns.text: I think he's fine, but the sudden noise is... well, it's a bit much.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: I brought these herbs for you to look at, maybe they'll help with the research stuff...

turns.speaker: tuk
turns.text: You can sit there and watch, Pip, but do not get in the way.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Okay so I'm totally not in the way, I'm just helping Biscuit stay calm...

turns.speaker: tuk
turns.text: Tuk will finish this brush, then go to the north field.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: That's fine, I'll just stay here and finish brushing this one then.

turns.speaker: ash
turns.text: Loosen your grip on the rifle. Four misses is too many.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Okay so I'm like, trying, but the grip is just totally weird...

turns.speaker: ash
turns.text: Relax your hand. You are squeezing the stock too hard.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Like this? It still feels so heavy and weird in my hands...

turns.speaker: rook
turns.text: Hm. Back's gone stiff. Get the rice moved, Pip.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Okay so that looked totally painful, like, do you need me to get Ines or something...?

turns.speaker: rook
turns.text: Don't need Ines. Just move the crate.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: You're totally being stubborn, but I'll move it if you're just gonna sit there...

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Okay so I totally just sliced my hand open on the wire, it's like, fine though...

turns.speaker: tuk
turns.text: Tuk will fix it, Pip, just keep the hand still.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: It's just a little scratch, Tuk, really, I'm totally fine!

turns.speaker: tuk
turns.text: Stop lying, Pip, the blood is coming too fast.

turns.speaker: moth
turns.text: I think, well, maybe you should take the medicine, because the bleeding... it isn't stopping as fast as it should.

turns.speaker: ash
turns.text: Negative. I do not need medicine. Just finish the stitches.

turns.speaker: moth
turns.text: I think, well, if you don't, the infection risk might be... higher than I'd like.

turns.speaker: ash
turns.text: Stitch the wound and be done with it.
